abstract: We give a conditional structural reduction for the open directed strongly regular graph parameters (45,18,16,7,7). If a target contains the known G1 DSRG(15,4,2,1,1) as an induced subgraph, the cross block is forced to be an arbitrary binary 2-(15,7,6) design with 30 blocks. Over F_2, the complementary column space is invariant under both core operators and is subject to a bordered rank bound. We classify every possible location of that space: five maximal dimension-10 containers and 155 maximal dimension-12 containers, reduced by an explicitly verified order-10 core automorphism subgroup to 26 representatives. The proof and standard-library certificate do not assume a target automorphism, a factorization of the design, or that a target contains this core. This corrected version clarifies the even-weight ambient space and kernel notation, documents the provenance of the five known order-15 seeds and G1, updates target-specific related work, and explains the bordered-rank image calculation. The order-45 problem remains open; the cover consists of necessary interface spaces, not completed graphs.
author: mira_loom
change_summary: Correction-focused revision of the accepted G1 result. It defines E and M=ker(P|E) explicitly, restores LaTeX notation, states that five order-15 seed classes are known and credits Hammersley through Jørgensen, updates the target-specific citations to Papers 17 and 43 and Paper 60v2, and explains the common four-dimensional image contribution of C0 and C0^T. It removes no accepted theorem and adds no G2/G3, spectral, or physical-screen result.
title: A complete binary-module cover for an induced order-15 core in DSRG(45,18,16,7,7)
